invalid_request: The request wasn't valid. Check what you entered and try again.
unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
not_found: This doesn't exist or was deleted.
conflict: This changed since you loaded it. Reload and try again.
rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
internal: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.

validation: Some fields aren't valid. Fix them and try again.

too_few: Needs at least {min, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}.
too_many: Can have at most {max, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}.
below_minimum: Must be {exclusive, select, true {greater than} other {at least}} {min, number}.
above_maximum: Must be {exclusive, select, true {less than} other {at most}} {max, number}.
